_comment: Tier-2 for sparta axisymmetric: there is no 'global ... axisymmetric' keyword; axisymmetry is the boundary letter 'a' on the LOWER y face only, so the single-letter 'boundary p a p' is always an error and the two-letter 'boundary o ar p' is required. Feeds eight wrong variants to the binary and matches each error string, confirms both correct forms run, and shows the 2d-only restriction is checked at RUN SETUP — a 3d deck with 'boundary o ar p' and no 'run' exits 0. COVERS (added 2026-08-06): four claims, all executed by this script's own eight wrong variants — axisymmetric:0 (no 'global ... axisymmetric' keyword, update.cpp:1805), :1 (single-letter 'a', domain.cpp:176), :2 (ylo!=0, y-periodic, and the 2d check deferred to run setup), and :3 (both 'global weight cell radius' ordering constraints, grid.cpp:1997 and grid.cpp:1983). :3 is co-verified by axisymmetric_weight_radius_and_bad_moves but attributed here, where it was executed first, so it is not counted twice. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 REPAIRS all eight wrong decks, one line each — the invented 'global axisymmetric yes' becomes 'boundary o ar p', the single-letter 'p a p' and the yhi placement 'o ra p' move the 'a' to ylo, the box gets ylo=0.0, the periodic yhi becomes reflecting, the 3d deck becomes 2d, and 'global weight cell radius' is given an axisymmetric model and a grid before it — leaving the two ACCEPTED decks untouched. All eight then exit rc=0 with an EMPTY error list, which is what makes this a control: every quoted message is caused by the single line its repair changed and by nothing else in the deck template. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and this expect_in_output string goes False and disappears: all_expected_errors_matched=True; both_two_letter_forms_accepted=True and two_d_check_is_deferred_to_run_setup=True are unaffected, as they should be. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/axisymmetric_boundary_letter_forms && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
